title: Wrong package name in version lookup
detail: The deprecation logic returns the version of the Werkzeug package instead of Jinja2, leading to incorrect information for users.

title: Condition inverted in __getattr__
detail: The code triggers deprecation logic for any attribute other than __version__, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. This causes normal attribute access to raise AttributeError and misleads users.
note: Says the condition is inverted: every attribute but `__version__` takes the deprecation path.

title: Wrong package name in deprecation warning
detail: The deprecation warning references Werkzeug and calls importlib.metadata.version("werkzeug"), which is incorrect for Jinja2. This will raise a PackageNotFoundError at runtime and mislead users.

title: Incorrectly skips evaluation of all non-model_config annotations
detail: The added block sets `hints[name] = (value, False)` for every attribute whose name is not `model_config`. This prevents the normal evaluation of field annotations, causing type hints to remain unevaluated and leading to runtime errors when the model is used.
note: Describes the planted flip: every annotation but `model_config` is left unevaluated.

title: Incorrect condition for firing partial response on cancel
detail: The condition triggers on any CANCELLED reason, even when the body should not be kept, causing a dataloss flag to be set incorrectly. It should only trigger when the stream is cancelled and the body is intended to be kept.
note: Describes the planted `or` and says it should need both.
